notes: Backlog car - both owner-approved small items from 2026-11-02, shipped together. 1) Configurable model timeout: the Settings model card now carries a 5..600 second 'model timeout' row (default 120, the previous fixed wait). Every path - console chat, Telegram turns, scheduled jobs - resolves it through the one config reader, so a slow upstream no longer pins every turn to two minutes; junk values are refused with an honest 400 and an untouched form never rewrites your settings. 2) Telegram typewriter streaming: a long reply now appears immediately as one message that updates in place (live preview with throttled edits, final edit carries the complete answer) instead of arriving all at once after the whole turn. Short answers still send as a single message exactly as before, an edit failure leaves the shown text untouched, and dry-run/channel routes never stream. Design notes and the test journey: docs/design/backlog_car_design.md.
